names.note: The forename and family name of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 14420, «Святитель Антоний (Быстров), архиепископ Архангельский и Холмогорский, сщмч.», with the rank word at the head, the see and the rank word at the end left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname — «Сщмч. Антония , архиепископа Архангельского (1931).» `fk.mjs` returns no holder for the form and none for the display name; the bare «Антоний» was deliberately not stored, the corpus keeping a great many of that name. Two folders already carry the surname as `andrew-bystrov` and `john-bystrov`, with no name in common with this one.

death.note: The year the day line prints for him: «Сщмч. Антония , архиепископа Архангельского (1931).» Neither page gives a year of birth and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Антония , архиепископа Архангельского (1931).»

attestations.note: The day’s thirteenth entry. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links to his name and to no reading, and name page 14420 prints the title, «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 3 июля», and the address of a parish church in Arkhangelsk named for him. What the name page adds over the day line is the surname «Быстров» and the fuller see, «архиепископ Архангельский и Холмогорский». `office` IS THE BARE WORD AND NOT THE SEE: `Archbishop` is in all four locale packs and the fuller title is in none of them, so the see is in this note and in the life and not in `office`. `new-martyr` was written on the ground that both his pages mark him a martyr and set the 26 января synaxis of the new martyrs beside his own day. The 26 января page was NOT read, and neither was the parish website. No folder was found for him.
